### Summary of Changes

1. **Contract & OpenAPI Synchronization**
   - Merged the 14 cross-context operation summaries from [openapi.yaml](file:///home/e2e/agents-v0-e2e/run-20261029-1629/work/portal-p2-n-integration-iam-cross-context-authorization-guard/docs/agents-v0/design/p2-n-integration-iam-cross-context-authorization-guard/openapi.yaml) into [openapi/api-v1.yaml](file:///home/e2e/agents-v0-e2e/run-20261029-1629/work/portal-p2-n-integration-iam-cross-context-authorization-guard/openapi/api-v1.yaml) and [app/backend/src/main/resources/openapi/api-v1.yaml](file:///home/e2e/agents-v0-e2e/run-20261029-1629/work/portal-p2-n-integration-iam-cross-context-authorization-guard/app/backend/src/main/resources/openapi/api-v1.yaml).
2. **Cross-Context Route & Instance Authorization (`AC-1`..`AC-6`)**
   - [`RbacManagementService`](file:///home/e2e/agents-v0-e2e/run-20261029-1629/work/portal-p2-n-integration-iam-cross-context-authorization-guard/app/backend/src/main/java/com/example/app/iam/service/RbacManagementService.java#L89-L243):
     - Evaluated `support.matchRoutePermission(method, requestUri)` in `evaluateRoute` before the self-service cancel check (`POST /api/v1/tickets/{id}/cancel`) so soft-deleted `governance:tickets:cancel` revokes route access immediately with `403 AUTH_FORBIDDEN` (`AC-4`).
     - Added `execution:runs:manage` (`EXECUTION_RUNS_MANAGE`) alias resolution (`AC-3`) and removed `governance:tickets:write` from the `governance:tickets:manage` alias so `View-As` roles and preparers cannot access `GET /api/v1/tickets?queueView=MANAGE` (`AC-2`, `AC-5`).
   - [`ReportRunOrchestratorService`](file:///home/e2e/agents-v0-e2e/run-20261029-1629/work/portal-p2-n-integration-iam-cross-context-authorization-guard/app/backend/src/main/java/com/example/app/execution/service/ReportRunOrchestratorService.java#L220-L666):
     - Added `enforceRunCancelAuthorization` (`triggeredByUserId == principal.userId()` or `execution:runs:manage` / `ADMIN` when `!readOnlyOverlay`) with non-rollback `AUTHZ_DENIED` (`DENIED`) audit logging (`AC-3`, `AC-5`).
     - Added service-layer `enforceNotInViewAsOverlay` defense-in-depth (`AUTHZ_DENIED` + `VIEW_AS_MUTATION_BLOCKED` audit events before throwing `403 VIEW_AS_MUTATION_FORBIDDEN`, `AC-6`).
   - [`ReportRunArtifactAndEndorsementService`](file:///home/e2e/agents-v0-e2e/run-20261029-1629/work/portal-p2-n-integration-iam-cross-context-authorization-guard/app/backend/src/main/java/com/example/app/execution/service/ReportRunArtifactAndEndorsementService.java#L168-L509):
     - Added `enforceRunEndorseAuthorization` (`triggeredByUserId == principal.userId()` or `execution:runs:manage` / `ADMIN` when `!readOnlyOverlay`) with non-rollback `AUTHZ_DENIED` (`DENIED`) audit logging (`AC-3`, `AC-5`).
     - Added service-layer `enforceNotInViewAsOverlay` defense-in-depth (`AUTHZ_DENIED` + `VIEW_AS_MUTATION_BLOCKED` audit events before throwing `403 VIEW_AS_MUTATION_FORBIDDEN`, `AC-6`).
   - [`GovernanceTicketWorkflowService`](file:///home/e2e/agents-v0-e2e/run-20261029-1629/work/portal-p2-n-integration-iam-cross-context-authorization-guard/app/backend/src/main/java/com/example/app/governance/service/GovernanceTicketWorkflowService.java#L660-L852):
     - Added `enforceReassignAuthorization` in `reassignTicket` so assigned tickets can only be reassigned by `ownerUserId`, `assigneeUserId`, or `governance:tickets:manage` (`ADMIN`), recording `AUTHZ_DENIED` (`DENIED`) on peer BOLA violations (`AC-3`, `AC-5`).
3. **End-to-End Integration Tests**
   - Added [`IamCrossContextAuthorizationGuardIntegrationTest`](file:///home/e2e/agents-v0-e2e/run-20261029-1629/work/portal-p2-n-integration-iam-cross-context-authorization-guard/app/backend/src/test/java/com/example/app/iam/IamCrossContextAuthorizationGuardIntegrationTest.java#L186-L293) covering `AC-1`..`AC-6` against live PostgreSQL.
